judgments.reason: The dataset README points to Kumaravel et al., EMBC 2021 for details. It has the same authors, and the paper analyzes the 8-channel BioWolf SSVEP recordings from six adults with clean and artifact-contaminated trials.
judgments.paper_title: Efficient Artifact Removal from Low-Density Wearable EEG using Artifacts Subspace Reconstruction
judgments.paper_venue: 2021 43rd Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine & Biology Society (EMBC)
